description: Image Description: The image depicts a sandy beach scene with a bright neon green frisbee lying partially embedded in the sand. The frisbee features a circular design with text and patterns printed in a contrasting gray or silver color, centered on its surface. Resting nearby is a pair of black flip-flops with a textured sole and a simple strap design; one flip-flop is slightly overlapping the other. The flip-flops are positioned just behind the frisbee.
